title: SneakerWatch Reveals $100 Nike Gift Card Facebook Contest Winner
description: http://www.sneakerwatch.com/ - Thank you to all who participated in our $100 Nike Gift Card giveaway contest, hosted on our Facebook Page. Be on the lookout for more contest/giveaways in the future via our social media accounts. You have until 6pm est time to claim your prize by inboxing our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/SneakerWatch .

asr.full_text: What's going on Snicket Watchers? Today we'll be announcing our winner for our $300 Nike gift card via our Facebook contest. Just like the last contest we will be using Fan Page Karma's Good Luck Fairy where they randomly select a winner via our criteria on the Facebook contest. And the winner is Rafi Rivendi. You have until 5 p.m. Eastern time to hit up our inbox on Facebook to collect your prize. All right, sneaker watchers, be sure to stay tuned to our Facebook page for any upcoming contest. Oh, Air Force Ones was the first drug dealer dream. Oh, I see this, buddy. That's what I can remember from 87, 88, 89. Air Force Ones has always just been a favorite of every hustler in Harlem. Again, being honest, a lot of these shoes aren't comfortable. I mean, back then, the technology for when he had the shoes, it was evolving to where it got to be now. It was like a light. You had to play and you had to pad. Exactly. But a lot of these shoes right now are not really comfortable. You're wearing them for looks.

textual.context: Presented as a Facebook contest/giveaway; the supplied records do not establish whether the offer is promotional, independently verified, or otherwise.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised gift card is tied to a required contact action and a time limit, which may require later assessment of the offer and claim process.
textual.limitations: The records give conflicting prize amounts and deadlines: the title and description state $100 and 6pm EST, while the ASR states $300 and 5 p.m. Eastern. No transaction, identity verification, or outcome is established.

visual.observation: A Facebook post from SneakerWatch visibly promotes a "Nike Gift Card Giveaway" and lists actions: like or favorite the Facebook post, share the contest post, and tag a friend; it states that a winner will be announced for a gift card.
visual.context: Visible promotional giveaway content; the supplied frames do not establish whether this is ordinary marketing, a demonstration, or another context.
visual.potential_relevance: A promised gift-card reward is linked to specified social-media engagement and recruitment-like actions, which conditionally merits review of the offer and its conditions.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether a gift card was actually awarded, whether participants paid or submitted sensitive information, or whether the promotion was legitimate.

visual.observation: A Fanpage Karma page displays the Facebook post and asks for a post URL before offering to identify winners; the page also visibly describes the process as "Quick, Reliable and without any guarantee."
visual.context: The interface appears to demonstrate or operate a winner-selection process for the visible giveaway; the relationship between the video and any audience instruction is unclear.
visual.potential_relevance: A destination requests entry of a Facebook post URL in connection with identifying a promised giveaway winner, while visibly qualifying the result with an absence of guarantee; this relationship conditionally merits review of the stated process and outcome conditions.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show a completed submission, redirect, payment, data collection beyond the visible URL field, or an actual winner notification.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a SneakerWatch Facebook giveaway announcing a Nike gift-card winner and a Facebook inbox contact step for prize collection, rather than an investment or payment-based offer. The winner selection is described as a random contest process using Fanpage Karma, with no established required payment, sensitive-data request, deceptive destination, or completed transaction. The remaining content concerns sneaker interviews and commentary, supporting an ordinary sneaker-media context.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central opening activity is an ordinary contest promotion: a Nike gift-card giveaway is announced, a winner is selected, and the winner is directed to contact the Facebook page to claim the prize. The description and ASR give conflicting prize amounts and deadlines, so no single amount or deadline is treated as settled.
